title: Shift-click after a page change edits a shape on the old page
reason: Reports Shift-click continuation appending to a prior page’s shape after the user changes pages without changing tools. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve’s PencilTool commits a new path on each gesture and has no Shift-click continuation mode that retains a prior shape across page changes. The specific stale continuation reference is absent.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s PencilTool commits a new path on each gesture and has no Shift-click continuation mode that retains a prior shape across page changes. The specific stale continuation reference is absent.

title: Switching tools during a text drag leaves an invisible text shape
reason: Reports a fixed-width text box left behind when the text tool is switched while a drag is active. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve `setTool` cancels the current canvas interaction before applying the tool change. `TextTool.onDragCancel` clears only the draft; text nodes are created on drag end, so a mid-drag switch cannot commit the empty box.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve `setTool` cancels the current canvas interaction before applying the tool change. `TextTool.onDragCancel` clears only the draft; text nodes are created on drag end, so a mid-drag switch cannot commit the empty box.

title: Switching tools during an arrow press leaves a stub arrow
reason: Reports an arrow created immediately on pointerdown remaining after the arrow tool is switched before the user moves. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve tool changes cancel the active canvas gesture first. `ArrowTool.onDragCancel` clears the draft, while the committed shape is created only on drag end; the reported press-then-switch artifact has no matching local path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve tool changes cancel the active canvas gesture first. `ArrowTool.onDragCancel` clears the draft, while the committed shape is created only on drag end; the reported press-then-switch artifact has no matching local path.

title: Escape after dragging a note from a clone handle keeps the note and switches tools
reason: Reports Escape during a tldraw note clone-handle drag keeping the newly created note and switching tools; the sole comment confirms fix #10187 sets a history mark before creation.
assessment: Varve has no note clone-handle gesture; note creation and duplication use other tool paths. This upstream history-mark fix does not directly transfer.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no note clone-handle gesture; note creation and duplication use other tool paths. This upstream history-mark fix does not directly transfer.

title: Escape during a crop drag reverts the whole crop session
reason: Reports Escape during a tldraw crop handle/picture drag consuming the crop session stopping point and reverting all prior crop adjustments, while leaving crop mode inconsistent.
assessment: Varve CropTool stages all crop adjustments in transient crop state and applies them only on Enter/Apply. Escape exits crop mode and discards the complete uncommitted session. That is a different interaction contract; the upstream partial-drag rollback expectation is not imported without a product-level need for per-drag crop checkpoints.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve CropTool stages all crop adjustments in transient crop state and applies them only on Enter/Apply. Escape exits crop mode and discards the complete uncommitted session. That is a different interaction contract; the upstream partial-drag rollback expectation is not imported without a product-level need for per-drag crop checkpoints.

title: Escape in image crop mode also clears the selection
reason: Reports Escape in tldraw image crop mode firing cancellation twice and clearing selection, unlike clicking outside the crop.
assessment: Varve CropTool Escape switches to Select without clearing the current selection, and the tool handler consumes the key before generic Escape handling. The duplicate-cancel and bubbling path described upstream is not present in the local handler.

title: A label drag on a deleted arrow leaves the select tool stuck
reason: Reports a label-drag release returning early when the arrow was deleted during the gesture, leaving selection stuck; the sole comment confirms fix #10183 always exits the pointing state.
assessment: Varve does not support the same hosted collaborative deletion path. A local delete shortcut during a canvas gesture is separately being evaluated under #10396; the report is kept linked as additional stale-selection-state context.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not support the same hosted collaborative deletion path. A local delete shortcut during a canvas gesture is separately being evaluated under #10396; the report is kept linked as additional stale-selection-state context.

title: Duplicating a page moves its shapes
reason: Reports tldraw page duplication using viewport-aware paste positioning and shifting content that was offscreen instead of preserving page coordinates. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve `duplicatePage` is a scene-level page operation that deep-copies page content and its node positions; it does not call viewport-aware paste placement. Existing page duplication tests cover copy ownership and content.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve `duplicatePage` is a scene-level page operation that deep-copies page content and its node positions; it does not call viewport-aware paste placement. Existing page duplication tests cover copy ownership and content.

title: Editing one embed makes every embed interactive
reason: Reports tldraw’s editing-one-embed state allowing pointer interaction on every embed on the page, so an unselected second embed takes the click. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve embeds are represented as document content and are not live interactive iframe components on the canvas; this interaction ownership state is not shared.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve embeds are represented as document content and are not live interactive iframe components on the canvas; this interaction ownership state is not shared.

title: "Unlock all" marks no undo stopping point
reason: Reports tldraw Unlock All mutating shapes without marking an undo boundary, causing one undo to revert an earlier unrelated change too. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve layer bulk locking wraps the mutation in `groupCompoundOperation`, which establishes the single undo boundary. The corresponding guide-only lock toggle is a separate operation. No missing stopping point was found in the matching bulk-layer workflow.
